text:
Jules: Quick sync  on onboarding UI variants  compact strip vs collapsed rail that expands. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/hybrid-rail-variant

Priya: Collapsed rail sounds promising for discovery without forcing layout shifts. Thinking about tour noise though  we should avoid shouting at users.

Noah: Behavioral data: persistent affordances = higher engagement. In last pilot, persistent rail variant had 2.8x sample project opens vs ephemeral banner. Worth optimizing for activation.

Elena: A11y checklist: ensure tab order includes the rail icon; when expanded trap focus; announce "Onboarding checklist expanded: X of Y complete" via aria-live; ensure contrasts meet 4.5:1 for text on CTA.

Tom: Dev constraints: rail collapsed by default (icon + progress ring). Expanding spawns an overlay for the checklist to avoid reflow. We'll persist progress flags server-side per-account. API stub: POST /v1/onboard/progress {flags: [..]} (debounced).

Jules: Microcopy suggestions: header "Continue your setup" not "Complete onboarding". CTA state-aware: 'Resume' vs 'Try samples'. Show micro-estimates: 'Add a sample project (2 min)'.

Priya: UX detail: show subtle progress percent and a small celebration when complete (no full-screen confetti). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Noah: Telemetry: events `onboard.rail.expand`, `onboard.item.complete` with props item_id, variant, ui_entrypoint. Capture duration_ms for items.

Elena: Keyboard nav: provide a hidden skip link to jump straight to checklist items; use role=list/listitem and aria-checked for toggles; ensure 44px hit targets on touch.

Tom: I'll prototype behavior and focus management this week behind `feature:onboard.hybrid_rail`. Will include unit tests for focus and an e2e for expand/collapse.

Jules: Sounds good. If no objections by EOD I'll update figma with copy variants and create the rollout plan.

OnboardingBot: Reminder: consider follow-up email nudge after 48h for users who started but didn't finish, only if email_opt_in=true.

Priya: :+1: love the hybrid approach.

Elena: Added a11y notes on Figma.

Noah: Will pull sample conversion numbers for the A/B doc.
